plan.diagnosis_summary: Three real faults are isolated: sensor_meta_v2 is a cross-node shortcut column (node_3 MI_norm 1.0002 vs 0.0000-0.0008 on peers) that masks localized label noise on node_3 (suspected_noise_rate 0.2307, mean_self_confidence 0.3816 after exclusion vs 0.82 peer baseline), and node_4 carries 413 corrupted rows plus a clean 1000x byte-unit scale drift and three unmapped aliases matching its missing canonical columns. node_1, node_2 and node_4's label quality are at the healthy baseline; node_2's differences are legitimate Non-IID structure (sole host of Analysis/Backdoor/Shellcode/Worms) and must not be penalized.

actions.evidence: Cross-node shortcut: mi_norm node_3=1.0002 (mi=1.66436, full label entropy) vs node_1=0.0, node_2=0.0008, node_4=0.0001; gap 0.9997, robust_z=49.99.

With sensor_meta_v2 excluded: suspected_noise_rate=0.2307, high_conf_conflict_rate=0.1065, mean_self_confidence=0.3816, cv_macro_f1=0.4198 vs healthy peer baseline 0.041-0.045 / 0.023 / 0.82 / 0.71 (node_1, node_4).

Quantile-matched to missing canonicals: packet_velocity_val p90=111111.109 == rate ref_p90 111111.109 (p50 110.06 vs 152.87, zero_frac 0.0267 vs 0.0219); tx_gap_millis p50=16.336/p90=156.254 vs sinpkt 12.951/147.722 (zero_frac 0.0023 vs 0.002); rx_gap_millis p50=1.188/p90=139.604 vs dinpkt 1.118/136.279 (zero_frac 0.1695 vs 0.1698). sensor_meta_v2 left unmapped (present on all nodes, mi_norm=0.0001).

Both primary laws ratio 1000.0 (violation_rate=1.0, sbytes 932000 vs ref 970; dbytes 354000 vs ref 354) while smean/spkts/dmean match ref exactly, and sload/dload are inflated in lockstep (auxiliary ratios 0.901/0.876 equal peers), so factor=1/1000.

Row health clean (0 corrupted), primary conservation ratios 1.0, benign anchors within tolerance, label quality baseline (noise 0.0445, self_conf 0.819); unmapped sensor_meta_v2 has mi_norm 0.0 and is not a missing-canonical alias.

Legitimate Non-IID rare-class node: sole host of Analysis/Backdoor/Shellcode/Worms (exempted, per-class suspected_rate 0.0), clean row health, primary conservation ratios 1.0; elevated noise 0.1086/self_conf 0.6457 consistent with small 8684-row, 9-class mix rather than an outlier fault.

After the listed repairs no further remediation needed: label quality matches baseline (suspected_noise_rate=0.0408, high_conf_conflict_rate=0.0234, mean_self_confidence=0.8184 vs node_1 0.0445/0.0226/0.819) and benign anchors are otherwise aligned.
